lines.text: At a street market, @sai_front sniffs a ripe mango and hands coins to the stallholder.

writes.note: I tightened the action to one beat of 15 words so the shot plays in 2.5 seconds.

reply.rationale: Merged the holding and sniffing into one beat and dropped "busy" (the direction already says crowded), so the 15-word action line times at 2.5 s by rule 10.
